## Summary

Describe the change clearly and concisely.

## Why

Explain the problem this solves or the reason for the change.

## Scope

- [ ] Frontend UI or state
- [ ] Onboarding
- [ ] Nuxt server proxy or WebSockets
- [ ] Authentication or security
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] DUMB backend coordination
- [ ] Other

## Testing

Describe what you tested and how.

- [ ] Not run (explain below)
- [ ] `pnpm test:log-parsers` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] Manual browser testing completed
- [ ] Mobile or responsive behavior checked when relevant

## Related issues

Link related issues, discussions, backend changes, docs changes, or follow-up
work.

## Checklist

- [ ] PR targets `dev` unless it is release automation or an exceptional
      maintainer change
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Changes are focused and scoped to one logical purpose
- [ ] DUMB backend compatibility or release ordering is documented
- [ ] DUMB_docs was updated when user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Sensitive values and local-only artifacts were not committed

## Notes

Add rollout notes, compatibility concerns, screenshots, or anything reviewers
should know.
